_notes: tree-sitter-c-sharp 0.23.5. functions: methods, constructors, destructors, operators, conversion operators, local functions, lambdas and anonymous methods (delegate(...){...}), mirroring JavaScript arrow/function expressions; lambdas/local functions inside a type get kind 'method' via the default method_containers (= classes), outside any type (top-level statements) kind 'function'. methods: the member declarations, always kind 'method'. Not definitions: property/indexer/event accessors (accessor_declaration also covers bodiless auto 'get;'), delegate_declaration (a signature-only type), namespaces. Bodiless abstract/interface/extern/partial method_declaration share the node type with real methods and cannot be separated by type, so they are counted. classes: class/struct/interface/enum/record (record_declaration also covers 'record struct'). Definition spans include leading attribute lists ([Fact], [HttpGet]) because the grammar puts attribute_list inside the declaration node; XML doc comments are separate comment nodes. Docs: '///' XML doc and '/**' comments. imports: using_directive (incl. using static / alias, global using) and extern_alias_directive; strings: regular, verbatim, raw and interpolated string literals (character_literal excluded). None of the listed types is also an anonymous token.
